subject: Council seat assignment and EB meeting orchestration for close plan
messages:
From: Caroline Miller <caroline@holloway.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Council seat assignment + EB meeting windowing for Holloway MAP

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Holloway's exec team wants to finalize sponsor assignments and lock an executive-briefing (EB) slot so we can hit our Q4 procurement runway. Attached is our current MAP spreadsheet (sheet tabs: stakeholders, eval-criteria, timeline). Can you help: 1) propose who from Redwood should map to our exec seats (CEO, CTO, Head of Data), and 2) provide 2–3 suggested EB windows (30–45 min) in the next 3 weeks?

High level asks:
- Confirm Redwood exec(s) to attend and which internal lead will own follow-ups
- Outline mutually agreed MAP milestones & a suggested close timeline to procurement signature
- Note any prerequisites you need from our side (security docs, demo scope)

Also cc'ing our procurement point (Adam) for timeline constraints.

Attachments: Holloway_initial_MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Caroline Miller
Dir. of Partnerships, Holloway Analytics
caroline@holloway.co

Caroline — thanks for the note and the attachment. I reviewed the MAP and have a quick proposal below. I've looped Ben (uptake & demo plan) and Monica (implementation scoping) so we can align internal owners.

Proposed Redwood attendees / roles for Holloway exec seats:
- CEO seat -> Marissa Cole (Exec sponsor, contract + commercial lead)
- CTO seat -> Priyom Das (technical strategy, architecture fit)
- Head of Data -> Ben Carter (demo & evaluation roadmap)

EB windows (PT):
1) Tue, 26 Sep 10:00–10:45
2) Thu, 28 Sep 14:00–14:45
3) Tue, 03 Oct 11:00–11:45

Action items for Holloway to help us finalize MAP milestones:
- Confirm procurement's target signature date (Adam)
- Share any specific security checklist items beyond SOC2 we should pre-review
- Point us to the internal evaluator(s) so Ben can tailor the demo script

I'll assemble a condensed MAP_v3 (one sheet: milestones + owners + due dates) and drop it in Drive by EOD. Can you confirm which EB window looks best?

Attachments: (see upcoming)

Thanks,

Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 08:21:00 -0700

Priyom / Caroline — procurement notes: Holloway is aiming to finalize commercial terms the week of Oct 9; ideal legal review complete by Oct 5. Constraints: finance closes Q3 books 30 Sep, so we need a signed order by 12 Oct to hit the internal vendor cutoff.

Security ask: we require the SOC2 Type II summary + any audit logs retention policy; I can accept a drive link to the materials.

Caroline: evaluator list below (primary/secondary):
- Sarah Kim, Head of ML Ops (primary) — sarah.kim@holloway.co
- James Park, Platform Eng (secondary) — james.park@holloway.co

I'll be at the vendor review on Oct 6; prefer the EB be completed by Oct 3 to give us time to fold the notes into our procurement packet.

—Adam

Thanks Adam — that timeline is helpful and aligns with Holloway's stated goals. Caroline — based on procurement constraints, we should aim to complete the EB by Fri, Oct 1 (latest Oct 3). I put together a condensed MAP_v3 that maps milestones to owners and dates; link below + attached snapshot.

Proposed MAP highlights (short):
- Milestone 1 — EB & data-demo: target 2028-10-01; Owner: Ben Carter
- Milestone 2 — Security evidence delivery (SOC2 summary + retention): target 2028-10-03; Owner: Monica Patel
- Milestone 3 — Commercial & legal terms agreed: target 2028-10-10; Owner: Marissa Cole
- Milestone 4 — PO submission & signatures: target 2028-10-12; Owner: Holloway Procurement (Adam)

EB candidate slots (we refined):
A) Fri, 29 Sep 09:30–10:15 PT — preferred if Sarah (Head of MLOps) is available
B) Tue, 03 Oct 11:00–11:45 PT — backup, earlier in day for Europe overlap
C) Wed, 04 Oct 14:00–14:45 PT — fallback

Notes for the EB agenda (30–45 mins):
- 5m: quick intros & success criteria
- 10–15m: technical fit & demo (Ben leads, targeted scenarios)
- 10m: security + data handling Q&A (Monica leads)
- 5–10m: commercial next steps & timeline (Marissa leads)

Attachments: MAP_timeline_gantt.png (snapshot), EB_candidate_bios.pdf (internal exec bios)
Links: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/4721/MAP_v3

Caroline — can you confirm Sarah's availability and whether Fri 29 Sep 09:30 PT would work? If not, can you lock Tue 03 Oct 11:00 PT as the backup? Once you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite and a short prep note for the Holloway evaluators.

Thanks,
Priyom

All — quick confirmation from our side:
- I'm happy to take the CEO seat; I'll lead commercial & SLA conversation on the EB.
- Priyom / Ben / Monica: please treat slot A (Fri, 29 Sep 09:30 PT) as penciled and I'll lock it once Caroline confirms Sarah. If Sarah can't do that time, lock slot B (Tue, 03 Oct 11:00 PT) and I'll handle exec calendar nudges.

Ben: please prepare a 10–12 minute demo that shows (a) latency on typical Holloway queries, (b) cost/throughput tradeoffs for 3 scale profiles, and (c) an evaluation script for Sarah's team. Send me the demo bullet points by EOD Fri so I can review.

Monica: please prioritize the SOC2 summary and a short note on audit log retention; share to the Drive link above.

Caroline / Adam: appreciate the timeline clarity — we will treat Oct 12 as the PO target and coordinate legal touchpoints.

Thanks,
